steps.en: Read the concepts table and sourced tips as a course, not as something to install
steps.zh: 把概念表和带出处的技巧当课程读，而不是当插件装

steps.en: Start Claude Code in a clone and run the demo command
steps.zh: 在克隆下来的仓库里启动 Claude Code，运行示例命令

steps.en: The command asks whether you want Celsius or Fahrenheit
steps.zh: 命令先问你要摄氏度还是华氏度

steps.en: A subagent fetches the temperature using a skill preloaded into it
steps.zh: 子 agent 用预装给它的 skill 去取气温

steps.en: A separate skill, called by the command, writes an SVG card and output.md
steps.zh: 命令再直接调另一个 skill，写出 SVG 卡片和 output.md

steps.en: Copy the command → agent → skill split into your own project's files
steps.zh: 把“命令 → 子 agent → skill”的分工照搬进自己项目的文件

value.en: You see how commands, subagents and skills hand off on a working example instead of piecing it together from scattered docs and tweets
value.zh: 在一个能跑的例子上看清命令、子 agent 和 skill 怎么交接，不用再从零散文档和推文里拼
